scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi there, I recently applied for a housing loan and I was wondering if you could help me with some details about my application. I applied for a conventional home purchase loan. I requested $155,000 for a 300-month term. I didn't request preapproval. Could you tell me the status of my application? Was it approved, denied, or is it still pending?
dialogue.agent: Your application for a conventional home purchase loan in the amount of $155,000 for a 300-month term has been denied.

dialogue.user: I see. Could you tell me the reason for the denial? Also, what was the interest rate that was considered for my application?
dialogue.agent: The principal reason for the denial was your debt-to-income ratio. The record does not include the interest rate that was considered for your application.

dialogue.user: I understand. Can you explain what my debt-to-income ratio means in this context? Also, are there any other reasons for the denial that you can share?
dialogue.agent: Your debt-to-income ratio (DTI) is the percentage of your monthly income that goes toward paying debts. In your case, it was between 50% and 60%. This was the only reason provided for the denial of your application.

dialogue.user: I see. Is there any additional information you can provide about the loan terms that were considered, such as the total costs or any high-cost flags?
dialogue.agent: The record does not include the total costs associated with the loan. Additionally, this loan is not classified as a high-cost mortgage under the Home Ownership and Equity Protection Act (HOEPA), and it does not have any negative amortization features.

dialogue.user: Thank you for the information. Has my loan been transferred or sold to another institution?
dialogue.agent: No, your loan has not been sold to another institution.

dialogue.user:
Thank you for the information. I understand the reasons for the denial and the details you've provided.

<Very Dissatisfied> The conversation was informative, but I'm disappointed to learn that my application was denied due to my debt-to-income ratio. I was hoping for a more favorable outcome.
